captures.description: THE CONSORTIUM, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Consortium on Electronic Literature (CELL) is an international, open-access collaboration that provides centralized access to digital literary databases, archives, and institutional repositories.' Pointers to 'The Index | CELL' and 'About CELL'; key facts and history (mission; 'Founded in 2009 by the Electronic Literature Organization (ELO)'; 'Hosted at the Center for Digital Narrative, University of Bergen in Norway'; 'the CELL Element Set metadata standard (2012–2013)' and The Index on 'curated Wikibase and Wikidata infrastructure'; the seven federated member archives by full name); an offer on submitting a database archive or exploring cataloged works. Two cards, both cellproject.net (The Index, About CELL).
